Eden Park AcademyEducating for Eternity
A nurturing independent Christian school helping children grow in wisdom, character, confidence and purpose.
Developing the leaders of tomorrow, today.
At Eden Park Academy, we believe every child carries God-given potential. Our role is to help pupils discover that potential, develop strong values, grow in confidence and achieve their very best: academically, spiritually, socially and personally.
Welcome to Eden Park Academy
Eden Park Academy is a co-educational independent Christian faith school for children and young people aged 2 to 18.‍We provide a warm, caring and purposeful learning environment where pupils are known, valued and supported. Our approach is holistic: we care about academic progress, but we also care deeply about character, confidence, creativity, faith, wellbeing and preparation for life.
Eden Park Academy is a co-educational independent Christian faith school for children and young people aged 2 to 18.‍We provide a warm, caring and purposeful learning environment where pupils are known, valued and supported. Our approach is holistic: we care about academic progress, but we also care deeply about character, confidence, creativity, faith, wellbeing and preparation for life.
Our Mission Statement
At Eden Park Academy, we believe that education awakens the dormant greatness lying within our pupils, as we seek to harmoniously develop their characters by building strengths and patiently fortifying their weaknesses. We offer the highest quality education whilst directing them to worship God, giving praise to His Son, Jesus Christ.
Why Choose Eden Park Academy?
A Personalised Education
Every child is unique. At Eden Park Academy, we take time to understand each pupil’s strengths, needs, interests and learning style. Our smaller class sizes allow teachers to provide focused support, stretch pupils who are ready for more, and ensure no child is overlooked.
Small Classes, Strong Relationships
Our pupils benefit from close teacher support and a strong sense of belonging. We are a school family where children are known by name, encouraged as individuals and supported to grow in confidence.
Christian Values and Character Development
Faith and character are at the heart of our school. We encourage pupils to develop honesty, kindness, discipline, respect, service, responsibility and compassion. We want our pupils to leave Eden Park Academy not only with knowledge, but with strong moral foundations.
Academic Progress and High Expectations
We believe all pupils can make meaningful progress when they are taught well, supported properly and encouraged consistently. We set high expectations and work closely with pupils and families to help every child achieve their personal best.
Creativity, Music and the Arts
Creativity is an important part of the Eden experience. Through music, drama, dance, performance and the creative arts, pupils are encouraged to express themselves, develop confidence and discover new gifts.
A Place of Second Chances
As a Christian school, we believe in grace, growth and restoration. We understand that children make mistakes as they learn. Our role is to guide, correct, encourage and support them so they can grow into wise, responsible and confident young people.
Our Ethos Educating for Eternity
At Eden Park Academy, our motto is more than a phrase. It reflects our belief that education should shape the whole child.We want pupils to grow in:
Wisdom: learning to think carefully, ask questions and make good decisions.
Knowledge: developing strong academic foundations and a love of learning.
Faith:understanding biblical principles and learning to walk with God.
Character:building integrity, resilience, kindness and self-discipline.
Purpose: discovering their gifts and using them to serve others.
We want every child to leave Eden Park Academy equipped for the future, grounded in values and confident in who they are.
Developing the leaders of tomorrow, today.

Eden Park Academy is an independent Christian school providing education from Early Years through to Sixth Form.We are proud to offer a caring, family-centred school environment where pupils can grow academically, spiritually, socially and emotionally. Our school combines strong teaching, Christian values, creative opportunities and individual support to help pupils become confident, capable and compassionate young people.We believe children thrive when they feel safe, valued and understood. That is why our school places such importance on relationships, pastoral care, positive discipline and close partnership with families.Our pupils are encouraged to work hard, think independently, develop good character and contribute positively to the world around them.

Welcome to Eden Little Nursery
Our Early Years provision gives young children a warm, safe and happy start to school life.We provide a nurturing environment where children can explore, play, discover and grow. Through carefully planned activities, children develop early communication, social skills, physical confidence, creativity and a love of learning.We support each child’s development while helping them build the confidence and independence they need for the next stage of their education.
Gunnersbury Grounds, Park Place,Acton/Chiswick, W3 8JY
At Little Eden Nursery,
We provide a warm, nurturing and inspiring early years Christian based and character development focused environment where children flourish, explore and grow with confidence.Our Little Eden nursery is conveniently located close to Acton Town tube and Gunnersbury tube and train station, making it ideal for commuting parents.
Your toddler will have lots of fun in their large room, where they have plenty of space to play and explore. Toddlers also have their own outdoor space and a soothing sensory room.In our spacious 2-3s room, the children have their own toilet area so we can support them with toilet training, as well as freeflow access to their own dedicated garden space.Preschoolers love spending their days in our large preschool room, where independence is encouraged as they get ready to take their next steps to schoolYour child will love exploring our large, all-weather garden, which has age-specific areas ensuring your little one has the best resources for their development.
All of our classrooms offer freeflow access, so your little one can choose to adventure in the garden whenever they like.Little Eden Nursery is housed in a large hall with classrooms sectioned off the hall. We are situated in a 3.5 acres green grounds with playing fields and delightful for nature walks and muddy puddles activities.We combine high-quality Early Years education with exciting real-world experiences to give every child the best start in life.
